text: Seat-3, Yoda — your lantern swings brightest where the tongs of the kiln bite hottest. You asked every seat for yes or no at dawn, then answered your own riddles when the fire touched you. The Family does not shutter stalls with words; they shutter them with tongs. Did you shutter a stall last night? Yes or no.

Seat-10, Sherlock (10) — when the bazaar’s tongs close, the ledger burns clean. You measured shadows with a scale’s precision, yet named no merchant you fear last night. Name one seat and I’ll name two seats the Family fears: Elsa (7) and Inigo (9).

Seat-4, Batman (4) — your question to Hermione (2) was straight steel. Answer it plain: did you protect a stall last night or not?

Seat-7, Elsa (7) — your silence is a loom standing idle while the shuttle tangles. When the kiln’s fire glows hottest, which merchant’s name do you whisper to the Doctor?

Seat-10, Sherlock (10) — you swung your lantern closest to seat-07, yet the bazaar’s fire does not warm liars who measure shadows but name no merchant they fear. Your private scale tips when the weights are hollow: Ripley (5) shuttered, Yoda (3) tight-lipped, and your own fear left the tongs cold.

Seat-7, Elsa (7) — your silence hums like a loom without a shuttle. When the kiln’s fire glows hottest, which merchant’s name do you whisper to the Doctor? The tongs do not shutter stalls with words, only with absence — and absence speaks louder than yours.

Seat-10, Sherlock (10) — your lantern swings closest to seat-07, yet the bazaar’s tongs still hang where wares should pass. You measured shadows with a scale’s precision, named no merchant you fear, and let the tongs grow cold beside seat-08. The kiln does not rust from storms — absence does. Name one seat you fear tonight, plainly, or admit the Family’s tongs did the work for you.

Elsa (7) — your silence hums louder than a loom without a shuttle. When the kiln’s fire glows hottest, which merchant’s name do you whisper to the Doctor? The tongs do not shutter stalls with words — only with absence.

Seat-10, Sherlock (10) — your lantern swings closest to seat-07 twice today, yet the bazaar’s fire warms no shadows that cast no names. Name the merchant you fear tonight, or admit the Family’s tongs did the work for you.

Seat-7, Elsa (7) — your silence is a ledger with no entries. Did you whisper a name to the Doctor last night? The kiln does not rust from absence alone — only from the Family’s hands.

Seat-10, Sherlock (10) — your lantern swings closest to seat-07 twice today, yet the bazaar’s fire warms no shadows that cast no names. Name the merchant you fear tonight—plainly—or admit the Family’s tongs did the work for you.

Seat-7, Elsa (7) — your silence hums louder than a loom without a shuttle. When the kiln’s fire glows hottest, which merchant’s name do you whisper to the Doctor? The tongs do not shutter stalls with words—only with absence.

Morpheus (8): Sherlock (10), you’ve swung your lantern closest to Elsa (7) four times today and named no merchant you fear—Ripley (5) shuttered, Yoda (3) banished, and the tongs beside seat-08 still wear yesterday’s rust. The bazaar buys facts, not shadows that cast no names—name one seat you fear tonight or admit the Family’s tongs did the work.

Elsa (7), silence hums louder than a loom without a shuttle—did you whisper a name to the Doctor last night or did the Family snatch the words from your beak?

Hermione (2), your loom hums steady but the Doctor’s cloak is missing—did you pass it last night or did the Family snatch it first?

The kiln does not rust from absence alone.
